caption:
One check on the tuner. The dot slid, overshot and settled in the middle, and the song had been fine all along.

Tuning first takes ten seconds, and it tells you whether the wrong note is you or the string.

For whoever tunes up before blaming the song.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a cream bar with a gold diamond above its middle and a coral dot at its left end. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the dot slides along the bar, overshoots, comes back and settles under the diamond, turning green with a small sparkle. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me tuning before I play.
